title: FloodConnect M8 layer readout (renamed from M7a's ring_readout)
description: Exactly the shape kb.py's `_answer_sandwich` assembles into `layers`, VERIFIED against the real code (2026-10-05): each of Z0/Z1/Z2/Z3 is a bare colour5 string -- Z0 = floodconnect_model.classify(z0_reading['status_word']), Z1/Z2/Z3 = floodconnect_model.ring_readout(rows, relation)['worst'] (only the 'worst' field is kept, not the whole ring_readout() dict). An empty/unread ring's `worst` is UNKNOWN (ring_readout's own default), never GREEN. The richer per-ring object (any_rising/at_or_over/n/n_fresh, documented in `$defs/ring_layer_full` below for reference) is what floodconnect_model.ring_readout() itself returns internally -- it is NOT what reaches the answer's `layers` key today; a caller wanting that detail must call ring_readout() directly, kb.py does not expose it through `layers`.

ring_layer_full.description: floodconnect_model.ring_readout()'s own full return shape -- reference only, not the shape of answer.layers.Z1/Z2/Z3 (see title note above).
